state: Gomrey candidate e333b5da71508639da2655342cb212381719c519, branch feature/rea/w3-evidence-bound-narrative, base main 5f299a7a6174ad3a1180f827778db5f4400a4d71. WHAT THE CHANGE DOES: adds servers/fastapi/gomrey/narrative.py, a pure domain module that builds a deterministic evidence plan from an existing EvidenceBundle and source IR; adds services/evidence_narrative.py, app-layer wiring; adds an 'evidence' keyword parameter to generate_ppt_outline and to the slide-content call, which injects the plan's closed fact base and evidence rules into the prompts; binds plan nodes to rendered slides and persists the binding in the existing SlideModel.properties column; persists the NarrativeIR and the source IR; runs an export-time citation revalidation; adds a deterministic containment check that every number and date a rendered slide states must already appear in a plan claim, reusing the P09-G2 quantity gate; extends contracts/v1/narrative-ir.schema.json additively with optional properties at version 1; and adds an alembic revision with two nullable JSON columns. WHICH AGENT TOOLS IT ADDS OR MODIFIES: none. No MCP tool, tool schema, tool registry, tool result shape or tool invocation path is added, removed or modified. The MCP server is untouched. The language-model calls that already produced the outline and the slide content before this change continue to produce them; this change only adds a deterministic plan in front of them, injects it into their prompts, and adds deterministic checks over their results. GATES ON THIS EXACT REVISION: root npm test 52/52; FastAPI pytest 1177 passed; Next.js node --test 73/73; contracts validator OK; contract tests 9/9; scan-secrets, check-fixtures, check-platform-support, validate-release-config and release-manifest all OK.
